江真真是从同学口中知道江晚要结婚的消息，她早在一年多前就在电视上看到过江晚，可是那个时候，她不过是配角，她对此嗤笑不已，觉得她不自量力。

她要是能火，她江真真的名字就倒着写。

可是这几个月，关于她的新闻却是源源不断，明显已经火了起来。

有熟悉的人，见面就问江晚，说她有个明星姐姐好福气。

江真真心底嫉妒得不行，她竟然真的红了。

如今她还要结婚了，结婚对象据说很有钱，这让她如何不嫉妒？嫁入豪门，是她的愿望，可是在她还不知道怎么嫁入豪门的时候，她向来看不起的江晚竟然要嫁入豪门了。

最让她眼红的是她名下竟然有公司。

如果她有钱了，她还需要嫁入豪门吗？

“爸爸，你看看江晚现在，那么红，名下还有公司，我托朋友问了，她那家娱乐公司，最低估价也是两亿，她还有一家投资公司，她得有多少钱？”

江源看着自家女儿，半信半疑，“她真能那么有钱？”

“爸，你不知道，娱乐圈可赚钱了。”江真真点头，“一个广告就是好几百万呢。”

“可是……当初我们做的那件事，她还能认我们？”江母有些踌躇，早知道江晚这么厉害，当初她何必将她嫁给一个糟老头子。

“她敢，我们是她唯一的亲人，她在我们家吃喝拉撒那么多年，于情于理都该孝敬你们吧？”

“就是，我们教养她那么多年，有钱了就想不认我们，想得美。”江源附和江真真。

江真真心底已经开始畅想，自己有钱后，将那些自己觉得和自己很遥远的东西都买回来。

其实这不是江真真第一次撺掇父母去找江晚，但是江源和江母都有些别扭之前要将江晚嫁人的事。

可是现在爆出来的两家公司，金钱的欲望把江源心底的那点别扭压了下去。

江晚不过一个女娃子，到时候嫁人那些东西还不是夫家？他老江家的东西，怎么能给外人？

江母听自家丈夫和女儿都这么说，心底也有了底气，她本来就是个贪财的，如今江晚那么大一块肥肉，她怎么可能放过？

一家人准备去京城找时笙。

因为没有时笙的电话，他们费了好大的劲才到漫天娱乐公司门下。

Jiang Zhenzhen learned about Jiang Wan's marriage from her classmates. She had seen Jiang Wan on TV more than a year ago, but at that time, she was just a supporting role. She laughed at it and felt that she was overestimating her abilities.

If she were popular, her name, Jiang Zhenzhen, would be written backwards.

But in the past few months, there has been a steady stream of news about her, and she has obviously become popular.

Some familiar people asked Jiang Wan when they met, saying that she was lucky to have a celebrity sister.

Jiang Zhenzhen was so jealous that she actually became famous.

Now she is getting married, and the person she is marrying is said to be very rich. How can she not be jealous?It was her wish to marry into a wealthy family, but when she didn't know how to marry into a wealthy family, Jiang Wan, whom she had always looked down upon, was actually marrying into a wealthy family.

What makes her jealous the most is that she actually has a company in her name.

If she is rich, does she still need to marry into a wealthy family?

"Dad, look at Jiang Wan now. She is so famous and has a company in her name. I asked a friend to ask her. The minimum valuation of her entertainment company is 200 million. She also has an investment company. How much money does she have?"

Jiang Yuan looked at his daughter with doubt, "Can she really be that rich?"

"Dad, you don't know, the entertainment industry can make money." Jiang Zhenzhen nodded, "One advertisement can cost millions."

"But...she can still recognize us after what we did?" Jiang's mother hesitated. If she had known that Jiang Wan was so powerful, why would she have married her to a bad old man in the first place.

"She dares. We are her only relatives. She has been eating and drinking in our house for so many years. She should be filial to you both emotionally and rationally, right?"

"That's right, we have been educating her for so many years, and she wants to disown us when she gets rich. It's a good idea." Jiang Yuan echoed Jiang Zhenzhen.

Jiang Zhenzhen has begun to imagine in his heart that when he has money, he will buy back all the things that he feels are far away from him.

In fact, this is not the first time Jiang Zhenzhen has persuaded his parents to find Jiang Wan, but both Jiang Yuan and Jiang's mother are a little awkward about marrying Jiang Wan before.

But with the two companies now exposed, the desire for money suppressed the awkwardness in Jiang Yuan's heart.

Jiang Wan is just a girl. When the time comes to marry someone, won’t those things belong to her husband’s family?How could he give the things belonging to his Lao Jiang family to outsiders?

Jiang's mother felt confident after hearing what her husband and daughter said. She was always greedy for money, but now how could she let Jiang Wan have such a big piece of fat?

The family is going to the capital to find Shi Sheng.

Since they didn't have Shi Sheng's phone number, they went through a lot of effort to get to Mantian Entertainment Company.
